cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

mechanism: A copies a tea spoon as a time measure and covers each currency objection by redefining when payment becomes usable.
confusable: D166 invents unmeasurable prices for favors; D167 redefines any instruction to force an outcome.
comparison: Useful shadow-hours bargain versus a repair paid with matured time.
seedUse: Preserve B today correction causing overnight maturation; remove only generic prefacing.
